issues.body: The new command uses `gh api repos/sparq-org/sparq/actions/workflows/codeql.yml`, but this repository and the surrounding documents identify the project as `jeswr/sparq`. The same bad owner/repo appears in `compliance/cis/evidence.md`. As written, the claimed authoritative re-verification is not reproducible against the project under review and will normally return a lookup error rather than `disabled_manually`.
issues.fix_hint: Change both new workflow-state commands to `repos/jeswr/sparq/actions/workflows/codeql.yml` (or derive the current repository dynamically), then ensure the documented expected output was obtained from that target.
issues.title: Authoritative verification command targets the wrong repository

issues.body: The updated text repeatedly says `codeql.yml` is byte-identical to main and that this PR does not modify it. This PR's diff explicitly modifies `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` by adding the operational-disable banner and notes. Even though its trigger semantics are unchanged, byte identity and non-modification are factual claims and are false on this PR head.
issues.fix_hint: Replace the byte-identity/non-modification claims with the precise invariant actually preserved: the workflow triggers and executable configuration are unchanged, while comments were updated in this PR.
issues.title: Document falsely claims codeql.yml is byte-identical and unmodified

issues.body: The changed code-scanning guidance says the live feeders are Scorecard and the Trivy image scan. In the same diff, `compliance/gap-register.md` GX-12 says there is no Trivy/Grype container-image scan and marks that gap OPEN; the CIS controls likewise describe the image-scanning half as uncovered. This creates a new false security-control claim while attempting to remove another one.
issues.fix_hint: Verify current CI reality and make all records agree. If GX-12 is still open, remove Trivy from AGENTS.md's live-feeder sentence. If a Trivy lane has landed, update the canonical GX-12 row and cite the actual workflow/job consistently in this PR.
issues.title: Live Trivy claim contradicts the repository's own open gap

verdict.summary: The reconciliation is directionally honest about disabled CodeQL, but it introduces contradictory and non-reproducible assurance evidence. Two purportedly authoritative workflow-state checks target a different repository, the branch-protection record falsely says codeql.yml is byte-identical/unmodified in this PR, and AGENTS.md claims a live Trivy image scanner while the same diff's gap register says no such scanner exists. These are material defects in a compliance/evidence-only change and must be corrected before approval. The diff also contains imperative agent-facing text, so injection detection is set.
